summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Trading Bot Phase 1 Foundation. All backend APIs (12/12) and frontend features (7/7) are working perfectly. System successfully provides real-time market data for 7 symbols, technical indicators, portfolio management, and kill switch functionality through simulated IBKR connector.

Features APIs - Technical indicators (RSI, MACD, volatility, ADX) for all symbols
Account API - Portfolio value, cash, P&L calculations
Dashboard API - Complete dashboard data aggregation
Orders API - Buy/sell order placement with realistic fills
Trades API - Recent trades history
